purpose: Prospective context-only evaluation of Kronos directional agreement on top-ranked Cluster captures.
score_rule: Use only five-minute bars fully completed by the Cluster capture as model context. Forecast timestamps and scoring begin at the first full five-minute regular-session bar strictly after capture. Compare direction with the close of the sixteenth such bar; Cluster directional return uses the final completed context close as reference.
decision_rule: Kronos remains context-only. Do not gate Cluster entries, rank exit profiles, or alter sizing before the minimum scored prospective sample is reached and a locked analysis demonstrates stable benefit.
notes: Only bars whose full five-minute interval completed at or before capture may enter model context.
Forecast and scoring timestamps begin at the first full five-minute bar strictly after capture.
The first stored prediction for a capture/ticker/configuration is immutable.
Predictions generated more than ten minutes after capture are audit-only and excluded from the prospective headline statistics.
No broker order or account endpoint is used.
